- AI Strategy, including the 45-day AI Transformation Intensive that delivers a roadmap and ROI estimates.
- AI Leadership & Facilitation, which transforms teams and executives through workshops and intensive sessions.
- AI Engineering, connecting systems and automating workflows to solve business problems.
- AI Agents, building AI assistants and automating processes with guardrails and human oversight.
